title: tests/userspace/test_dm_crypt.sh: dm-crypt loopback encryption test
description: Shell script that creates a loopback block device, sets up dm-crypt with aes-xts-plain64 (the dm-crypt cipher string), writes a known pattern, reads it back, and verifies data integrity. Also verifies via /proc/crypto that the xts(aes) operation used the wolfkm driver. Requires root. Uses losetup, cryptsetup, mkfs.ext4. Cleans up loop device and dm device on exit.
design: Steps: dd if=/dev/urandom of=/tmp/wolfkm-test.img bs=1M count=64; losetup /dev/loop99 /tmp/wolfkm-test.img; cryptsetup luksFormat --type plain --cipher aes-xts-plain64 --key-size 256 /dev/loop99; cryptsetup open --type plain ...; mkfs.ext4 /dev/mapper/wolfkm-test; mount; write 10MB file; sha256sum; umount; cryptsetup close; reopen; remount; sha256sum; compare. See DESIGN.md §test_dm_crypt.
